title: docs(skills): teach the fault edge on a write after an approval decision and the RESUME_FAILED refusal members
body:
Fixes #34637

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：自动化技能的审批参考新增一条：审批通过或拒绝之后的「改记录」步骤，如果可能被记录钩子、校验规则或权限拒绝，就从这一步画一条 fault 边到处理节点，拒绝走这条边，审批照常返回；不画时审批接口回 500 `RESUME_FAILED`，决定照旧生效，错误体带 `innerRefusal` 和 `userMessage`。另加一条评测用例。
- 为什么改：技能不教，AI 写审批流程时不会画这条边，钩子一拒绝流程就卡住，审批人只看到 500。
- 风险与回滚：只动技能文字和评测，不动运行时。为了不抬 token 上限，同一文件删了四处重复内容，每处都另有出处。回滚就是 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：① `skills/objectstack-automation/references/state-machines-and-approvals.md` 里 Branching 一节新增的那一条，以及同文件被删的四处；② `skills/objectstack-automation/evals/approval-fault-edge.json`；③ `.changeset/34637-approval-fault-edge-skill.md`。
- 两分钟验证：跑 `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`，预期这份参考文件一行读作 `5913 tokens (ceiling 5916; headroom 3)`，末行是 ✓。
- 需要你做的：审批本 PR（受管面 `skills/**`）。

## What changes

`skills/objectstack-automation/references/state-machines-and-approvals.md`, section *Branching, side-effects & rejection*, gains one bullet. It teaches the two points the card orders, in the wording of the merged approvals docs callout and the `ApprovalDecisionResult.resumed` docblock:

1. When a step on the `approve` / `reject` branch writes a record that a record hook, a validation rule or a permission may refuse, draw a `fault` edge from that step to a handler. The refusal takes that edge and the decision answers normally.
2. Without the edge, `POST …/approve` (or `/reject`) answers `500 RESUME_FAILED`. The decision stands (`finalized: true`), the run is stranded, and the body carries `innerRefusal` (`{ code, message }`) and `userMessage`, the hook's declared sentence to show the approver.

The bullet points to SKILL.md, section *Failure routing*, for the edge shape, so the shape is not restated.

One eval case is added in a new file, `skills/objectstack-automation/evals/approval-fault-edge.json`: an approval flow whose step after the decision updates a record guarded by a refusing `beforeUpdate` hook. It is graded on the approval node, the `approve` out-edge, the `update_record` step and the `type: 'fault'` edge.

A `@objectstack/skills` patch changeset is included, because `skills/**` ships in that package.

### The status code, checked against the merged code and the ruling

The card says "status 500 per the standing ruling". The merged code answers the same:

- `packages/rest/src/approvals-routes.ts` maps the `RESUME_FAILED` prefix to status 500 and spreads the recognised stranded-decision envelope into the body.
- `packages/rest/src/rest-approvals-wire-codes.test.ts` pins status 500 and the exact body key set `code`, `decision`, `error`, `finalized`, `innerRefusal`, `repairable`, `runId`, `userMessage`.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/hook-refusal-after-decision.test.ts` pins both halves: no fault edge gives `RESUME_FAILED` with the two members, and a fault edge on the step gives `finalized: true, resumed: true` with nothing left parked.

The ruling the code cites is the maintainer ruling of 2026-09-04, decision batch #37, option 1B, recorded in comment 5541861039 on issue #13807. From that record: "`POST …/reject` (and the sibling decision doors on the same path) **keeps its status code** — the 500-class `RESUME_FAILED` — and stops discarding what the engine said". The record gives the maintainer's word as verbatim 「同意」 on the presented recommendation `1B · 2及`. The approvals docs page states the 500 and cites no ruling id of its own; the id is in the code comments (`approvals-routes.ts`, `packages/types/src/stranded-decision.ts`).

### Scope fence

Only the decision doors' thrown `RESUME_FAILED` envelope is taught, as merged by PR #34619. The text names `POST …/approve` and `/reject`. It does not mention `resumeFailure`, the recall door or the subflow-parent strand, and it does not say those answers carry the pair.

### Budget

The reference file was at 5916 tokens against a ceiling of 5916, headroom 0. No ceiling moves. The new bullet is paid for by deleting content. Four restatements were cut, each keeping another home:

| Bullet "Send back for revision (ADR-0044)", a pointer | 80 | The section it pointed to, in the same file |
| Bullet "Hard reject" | 64 | The examples' `reject` edges into an `end` node (`e3`, `e7`) |

The cuts remove 524 bytes and the new bullet adds 515, so the file is 9 bytes smaller. None of the four is a re-wrap: each removes text.

## Tests

No package source changes, so no package test suite is owed. What ran, at head `fcf9e05cbe`:

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/skills build` under the shared verify lock: `VERDICT command-exit 0`; "99 file(s) across 12 skill(s) copied from skills/** into dist/skills and read back byte-identical".
- The new eval case, by hand. The `skill-evals` runner has no single-case selector, so five turns of this one case were run with the runner's own argv from `packages/qa/scenarios/src/skill-evals/arms.ts` (a fresh directory, the bundle copied without `evals/` on the with-skill arm, an empty directory on the no-skill arm) and graded by literal substring as `grade.ts` does. This is a hand replication, not a runner round, and no round record was filed.

| Turn | Arm | Reference text it read | Verdict under the final tokens |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| ws1 | with-skill | first revision (`5fa36a038b`) | pass |
| ws2 | with-skill | final text | pass |
| ws3 | with-skill | final text | pass |
| ns1 | no-skill | none | fail: `label: 'approve'` missing, `type: 'role'` present |
| ns2 | no-skill | none | fail: `label: 'approve'` missing, `type: 'role'` present |

All three with-skill answers drew the `type: 'fault'` edge from the `update_record` step, and all three said that without it the approve call answers `500 RESUME_FAILED`. All three launched the skill and read the reference file.

Stated limits: the token lists were settled after reading these answers, so the five turns are not an independent test of the final lists. Two things changed on the way. Both no-skill answers also wrote `type: 'fault'`, so the case now also requires `label: 'approve'` and forbids `type: 'role'`. The first draft forbade `label: 'error'`, and one with-skill answer that drew the fault edge correctly quoted that label while explaining why it does not catch a failure, so that token was dropped. The prompt was the same on all five turns.

## Acceptance notes

- The first eval draft appended a case to `evals/flows-triggers-approvals.json`. `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs` then answered `VERDICT overlap exit 1` against PR #34793, which appends its own case with the same `id: 24` at the same position. The case moved to its own file and the shared file is byte-identical to `main` again. The re-run answers `VERDICT clean exit 0` against `origin/main` (`44c7a4a415`) and 0 PR heads.
- The discount-approval example in the reference keeps its `mark_won` step without a `fault` edge. The new rule is conditional (a write that may be refused), and adding a handler node and two edges to the example did not fit the budget. Noted, not changed.
- `ui/scripts/check-skill-eval-tokens.mjs` scans the bundle under `ui/skills` only (1 bundle, 11 eval files), so it does not judge this case. The four `must_contain` tokens were checked by hand as taught in the bundle: `type: 'approval'` and `label: 'approve'` in the reference, `update_record` in SKILL.md and the references, `type: 'fault'` in SKILL.md. The forbidden token `type: 'role'` occurs nowhere in the bundle.
- Case 5 of `evals/flows-triggers-approvals.json` forbids `label: 'error'` and has the same exposure measured above on a different prompt. Noted, not filed.
